This directory contains external software that is used in the VPTP project, and has been found to be useful in cyberphysical systems research. The software is not maintained by the VPTP team, but is included here for convenience, and installed via the `install.sh` script.

# External Software
- [ICSim](https://github.com/zombieCraig/ICSim) for educational purposes
- [UDSim](https://github.com/zombieCraig/UDSim) for educational purposes
- [OpenDBC](https://github.com/commaai/opendbc) for reading and writing DBC files, and keeping track of vehicle databases
- [SavvyCAN](https://www.savvycan.com/) for remote CAN analysis
- [GNU Radio](https://www.gnuradio.org/) for SDR applications
- [Scapy Automotive](https://scapy.readthedocs.io/en/latest/installation.html) for packet crafting and injection
- [Jupyter Lab](https://jupyter.org/) for big data analysis
- [Canmatrix](https://github.com/ebroecker/canmatrix) for reading and writing several database formats (e.g. .dbc, .dbf, .kcd, .arxml)
- [rpi_hardware_pwm](https://github.com/Pioreactor/rpi_hardware_pwm) for bitbanging via the PWM pins on the Raspberry Pi
- [Sigrok](https://sigrok.org/wiki/Main_Page) for a bitmagic basic logic analyzer
- [OpenOCD](https://openocd.org/) for the Tigard Protocol Tool and quick debugging of embedded systems

# External Python Libraries
- [Python-CAN](https://pypi.org/project/python-can/) for CAN bus communication
- [Py-UDS](https://pypi.org/project/py-uds/) for UDS communication
- [Python-can-isotp](https://github.com/pylessard/python-can-isotp) for ISO-TP communication
- [Python-can-j1939](https://github.com/juergenH87/python-can-j1939) for J1939 communication
- [OBD](https://python-obd.readthedocs.io/en/latest/) for OBD-II communication
